summary:
Main
Iron ore futures firmed modestly today. The DCE most-active contract I2701 settled at RMB 714/mt, up 0.85% from the previous session.Spot prices at Qingdao Port rose RMB 2-3/mt from the previous trading day. Traders were reasonably active in offering, while mill purchases were largely restocking on a just-in-need basis, leaving overall spot transaction volumes moderate.Iron ore fundamentals remained steady this week, with demand likely to contract slightly in the near term.
